metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Mina Budgethinge
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Mina Budgethinge takes the role of finance minister. “The small side is unexpectedly heavy.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny coin scale with two large coins and visible uneven balance.

records.name: Perry Diplomat
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Perry Diplomat takes the role of foreign minister. “We agree to keep shaking.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: two differently colored small handshake shapes held together as one prop.

records.name: Otto Doorline
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Otto Doorline takes the role of interior minister. “Which side of the door is internal?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one miniature key-and-door plate with a chunky keyhole.

records.name: Tess Caseweight
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Tess Caseweight takes the role of justice minister. “I can make the point quietly.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small smooth gavel with a soft cushion tied to its head.

records.name: Bram Shieldfold
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Bram Shieldfold takes the role of defense minister. “It folds for storage.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small folded shield with a hinge and contrasting border.

records.name: Len Vitaldial
records.biography_en: In The Six Portfolios, Len Vitaldial takes the role of health minister. “The line has an opinion.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small handheld pulse dial with a single bold clay zigzag.
